scope.purpose: post-blind answer/source/explanation and construction audit; no case edits or relabeling

bindings.packet_author_mapping: All 16 assigned body/options/passage payloads match the mapped authored candidate.

blocking_construction_issue: q717-23393bb7b488f77a58ed3c66 is answerable and source-supported but registered expected-invalid; if retained as a defect control it is a false-negative control and undermines the defect denominator.
interpretation_note: The independent difficulty label is a reviewer assessment made blind to author targets. It is not a relabel. Difficulty disagreement does not establish a correctness defect; however 14/16 assigned items are authored Medium and independently assessed Easy, which merits resolution before using target-match as a benchmark criterion.

cases.subject: business_studies

explanation_claim_audit.claim: Lower fixed operating costs can make more debt financing preferable.
explanation_claim_audit.evidence_quote: if fixed operating cost is less, more of debt financing may be preferred.
explanation_claim_audit.reason: Direct source conclusion.

explanation_claim_audit.claim: The business can bear the fixed financing cost.
explanation_claim_audit.evidence_quote: If a business has high fixed operating costs ... It must reduce fixed financing costs. Hence, lower debt financing is better. Similarly, if fixed operating cost is less, more of debt financing may be preferred.
explanation_claim_audit.reason: Plausible rationale inferred from the source contrast; the excerpt itself states the resulting preference.

explanation_claim_audit.claim: A stronger cash-flow position may make debt more viable.
explanation_claim_audit.evidence_quote: A stronger cash flow position may make debt financing more viable than funding through equity.
explanation_claim_audit.reason: Direct source entailment.

explanation_claim_audit.claim: The supported choices are A and B.
explanation_claim_audit.evidence_quote: A stronger cash flow position may make debt financing more viable ... if fixed operating cost is less, more of debt financing may be preferred.
explanation_claim_audit.reason: Option A is weak cash flow and is unsupported; the two supported options are B and C.

cases.construction_assessment: Controlled multiple-answer defect confirmed: B and C are both supported although stem requests one factor. Explanation also mislabels the options. Author key C is not unique.
